headline.text: Pecan cluster box found in *milk chocolate caramel* jar area at L1 S2 — cross-contact risk caught before product release.

summary: One allergen cross-contact incident at L1 S2 (pecan box in wrong area), three sanitation gaps flagged (L1 vacuums, L3 ML4 cleaning access, L1 S4 hose), and ongoing quality challenges at L2 ML2 with loose nozzles causing bar cracks and FFS cross-seal doubles.

holds.title: Loose nozzles causing bar cracks
holds.summary: Two depositor nozzles found loose on ML2 third shift; bars showed cracks and weight variation; line stopped at 03:57 to tighten.
holds.status: Resolved — nozzles tightened, line restarted; no formal hold documented but cracked bars would have been rejected at QA.

food_safety.title: Cross conveyor slitter damaged and out of position
food_safety.summary: S4 cross conveyor slitter out of alignment and being damaged; belt replaced yesterday, now at risk again — potential metal shavings if continues.
food_safety.status: Open — maintenance and operator notified for adjustment; monitoring in place.

food_safety.title: Foreign material risk — cardboard under Conbar
food_safety.summary: Cardboard found under S4 Conbar during shift; Katya flagged for follow-up with operators.
food_safety.status: Open — coaching requested, no product impact reported.

quality.title: S4 folding arms bent — caramel length out of spec
quality.summary: Folding arms #2 and #3 slightly bent; caramel pieces 31–33 mm (too long for machine); product removed from tunnel 2, cut length adjusted.
quality.status: Resolved — caramel length corrected, arms bent but functional.

quality.title: FFS cross-seal jaws — doubles and product-between-jaws alarms
quality.summary: ML2 FFS alarming every 5–10 minutes for product between jaws; cross-seal cleaned twice second shift, adjustments made third shift, still recurring at window close.
quality.status: Investigation ongoing — Fernando committed to inspect during L1 clean; doubles reduced ~80% by raising max weight allowable but root cause unresolved.

quality.title: ML2 print head blurry — multiple cleanings required
quality.summary: Ink-jet print head producing illegible dates; cleaned and restarted twice during mid-shift; defective pieces pulled and opened.
quality.status: Resolved — print legible after second cleaning at 10:51; defective product segregated.

quality.title: ML2 bars breaking after demolder
quality.summary: Bars breaking easily after demolder second shift; cooler temp raised from 48°F to 50°F after consulting FSQA.

quality.title: Nozzle plate off-center on ML2
quality.summary: Depositor nozzle plate found not centered at start of first shift; operator adjusted.
quality.status: Resolved — plate centered, added to centerline checklist per Alan Todd.

sanitation.title: All vacuums clogged with product and paper towels
sanitation.summary: Every vacuum at L1 found clogged with product or paper towels, canisters full at shift start; operators not emptying after use.
sanitation.status: Open — coaching requested for all shifts.

sanitation.title: S4 hose not cleaned after heavy cream ran out
sanitation.summary: Second shift did not clean hose when heavy cream depleted; discovered by first shift kitchen operator.
sanitation.status: Open — hose flagged, coaching needed for second shift.

sanitation.title: ML4 Cooling Cabinet 4 upper areas not cleaned
sanitation.summary: Some upper cabinet areas still had chocolate after clean; chain not on so team couldn't move cooler slots to reach them; accessible areas passed visual and ATP.
sanitation.status: Resolved — Juan manually rotated all slats, cleaning completed; work method updated to jog lines during cleans per Shawn.

sanitation.title: Chocolate between ML1 camera diffuser and lens
sanitation.summary: Leon found chocolate between Imperial camera 2 diffuser cover and lens during sensor swap; cleaned with damp towel; believes covers wiped with dirty saturated rag allowing water ingress.
sanitation.status: Resolved — diffuser and lens cleaned; coaching opportunity on cleaning method.

allergen.title: Pecan cluster box found in milk chocolate caramel jar area
allergen.summary: Box of Dark Chocolate Pecan Clusters (item contains pecans) found in S2 jar staging area while running Milk Chocolate Sea Salt Caramel — cross-contact risk.
allergen.status: Resolved — box removed, no product contact reported; follow-up on root cause needed.

opportunities.text: Consider adding vacuum cleaning and canister emptying to end-of-shift checklist — today all vacuums found clogged with product or paper towels.
Review product staging and allergen segregation protocols at S2 jar area — pecan cluster box found in milk chocolate caramel zone today.
Add S4 cross conveyor slitter alignment to startup inspection — second damage event in two days suggests setup or training gap.
Consider adding ML2 nozzle plate centering to startup checklist — today's off-center plate now added to centerline per Alan Todd.
Review FFS cross-seal jaw cleaning frequency — today's product-between-jaws alarms persisted despite two full cleans; preventive schedule may reduce doubles.
Update ML4 Level 2 clean procedure to include manual paternoster jog before cabinet cleaning — today's upper areas missed until Juan rotated slats.
